description: Turns the comprehension debt left by vibe coding into active learning: generates questions about your own code, grades your answers, and tracks what you actually understand. UI and generated questions are Japanese only for now.
command.startSession.title: Fathom: Start comprehension check (current file)
command.showRecentFiles.title: Fathom: Open a recently checked file
configuration.pythonPath.description: Absolute path to the Python executable used to launch the Fathom backend (main.py) — e.g. the python.exe of a conda env. The backend cannot start while this is unset.
configuration.ollamaModel.description: Ollama model used to generate questions and grade answers (e.g. "qwen2.5-coder:7b"). Must be a model you have already pulled; run "ollama list" to see the names. When empty, the first model Ollama reports is used. If the value does not match any pulled model, Fathom falls back to that first model. Applies when the backend starts, so reload the window after changing it.
configuration.outputLanguage.description: Language the LLM writes its generated questions, grading feedback, and follow-up project ideas in. Note that the panel UI itself is Japanese only regardless of this setting. Takes effect from the next generated question onward; existing history keeps the language it was created in.
